description: Construction of a first floor rear extension; enlargement of front and rear roof dormers and the change of the first floor to a 1x1 bed flat and second floor and third floor to a 1x2 flat.
decision_conditions: <p><span id="docs-internal-guid-7f7b2590-7fff-cc90-19f6-5d4ca47dc4be"><span style="font-size: 10pt; font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; vertical-align: baseline; white-space-collapse: preserve;">In the absence of a Unilateral Undertaking or a Section 106 Agreement securing appropriate mitigation by restricting future occupiers of the development from obtaining parking permits within the Controlled Parking Zone, the proposed development would likely exacerbate existing parking stress and congestion on the surrounding highway network. The development would, therefore, be contrary to policies LP43 (Transport and Development) and LP45 (Parking and Car Free Development) of the Hackney Local Plan 2033 and policies T4 (Assessing and mitigating transport impacts) and T6 (Car parking) of the London Plan 2021.</span></span></p>

<p><span id="docs-internal-guid-55e0ec2e-7fff-08bf-9b30-1db7f1db01cc"><span style="font-size: 10pt; font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; vertical-align: baseline; white-space-collapse: preserve;">In the absence of a robust Energy Statement and an Overheating Risk Assessment, the development fails to demonstrate how the maximum feasible reduction in carbon emissions and overheating mitigation have been achieved on site, contrary to policies LP54 (Overheating and Adapting to Climate Change) and LP55 (Mitigating Climate Change) of the Hackney Local Plan 2033) and policies SI 2 (Minimising greenhouse gas emissions) and SI 4 (Managing heat risk) of the London Plan 2021.</span></span></p>

<p><span id="docs-internal-guid-3a9ee8f2-7fff-2c44-e4b0-481f3b9af550"><span style="font-size: 10pt; font-family: Arial, sans-serif; background-color: transparent; font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; vertical-align: baseline; white-space-collapse: preserve;">In the absence of a Construction Management Plan, the proposed development fails to demonstrate that construction activities would be adequately managed to minimise impacts on the surrounding highway network, pedestrian safety and local amenity, and may result in obstruction and increased disruption in the area which is contrary Policies LP43 (Transport and Development) of the Hackney Local Plan 2033, and Policies T4 (Assessing and mitigating transport impacts) of the London Plan 2021.</span></span></p>

<p><span id="docs-internal-guid-6a66ee9a-7fff-0462-4ac0-277bec119924"><span style="font-size: 10pt; font-family: Arial, sans-serif; background-color: transparent; font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; vertical-align: baseline; white-space-collapse: preserve;">The proposed development, by reason of the insufficient information and inadequate provision of cycle parking, fails to demonstrate that cycle parking would be safe, secure and conveniently accessible for all users. The proposal would therefore be contrary to T5 (cycling) of the London Plan 2021 Policy LP42 (Walking and Cycling) of the Hackney Local Plan 2033 and the Hackney Transport Strategy 2015-2025.</span></span></p>

<p><span id="docs-internal-guid-6431e072-7fff-4a19-d4e2-3a55589a1e27"><span style="font-size: 10pt; font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; vertical-align: baseline; white-space-collapse: preserve;">The proposed development, by reason of its design and detailing, fails to respond appropriately to the character and appearance of the host building, the terrace, and the Clapton Square Conservation Area. As a result of the proposed inappropriate alterations, the proposal would cause less than substantial harm to the significance of the Conservation Area, which is not outweighed by any public benefits. It is therefore contrary to Policies D3 (</span><span style="font-size: 10pt; font-family: Arial, sans-serif; background-color: transparent; font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; vertical-align: baseline; white-space-collapse: preserve;">Optimising Site Capacity Through The Design Led Approach) </span><span style="font-size: 10pt; font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; vertical-align: baseline; white-space-collapse: preserve;">and D4 (Delivering Good Design) of the London Plan 2021, Policies LP1 (Design and Quality and Local Character) LP3 (Designated Heritage Assets) and LP4 (Non Designated Heritage Assets) of the Hackney Local Plan 2033, the Residential Extensions and Alterations SPD 2025, and the Clapton Square Conservation Area Appraisal.</span></span></p>

<p><span id="docs-internal-guid-c5291e8f-7fff-4762-30d4-7e2bf2ff22c9"><span style="font-size: 10pt; font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; vertical-align: baseline; white-space-collapse: preserve;">The proposed roof terrace, by reason of its position and design, is not a characteristic feature of the area, would erode the architectural integrity of the building, harm the established consistency of the terrace, and result in adverse impacts in terms of loss of privacy, overlooking, noise and disturbance on the amenity of adjoining occupiers. Accordingly, the proposed roof terrace is considered unacceptable and contrary to Policies D3 (</span><span style="font-size: 10pt; font-family: Arial, sans-serif; background-color: transparent; font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; vertical-align: baseline; white-space-collapse: preserve;">Optimising site capacity through the design led approach ) D14 (Noise) </span><span style="font-size: 10pt; font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; vertical-align: baseline; white-space-collapse: preserve;">of the London Plan 2021 and Policies LP1 (Design Quality and Character) and LP2 (Development and Amenity)&nbsp; of the Hackney Local Plan 2033.</span></span></p>

<p><span id="docs-internal-guid-93b45a9f-7fff-a074-2155-07dc31034378"><span style="font-size: 10pt; font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; vertical-align: baseline; white-space-collapse: preserve;">The proposed development has failed to justify the proposed unit mix, which would provide an inappropriate dwelling mix and result in the loss of an existing family sized dwelling. This would reduce the supply of larger homes within the borough contrary to H9 of the London Plan 2021 (Ensuring the Best Use of Stock) LP14 (Dwelling Size Mix) and LP19 (Residential Conversions) of the Hackney Local Plan 2033.</span></span></p>

<p><span id="docs-internal-guid-f02bdf17-7fff-e1ee-f504-0ddfd253021a"><span style="font-size: 10pt; font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; vertical-align: baseline; white-space-collapse: preserve;">The applicant has failed to provide sufficient information in the form of a viability appraisal, nor agreed to enter a unilateral undertaking to contribute towards affordable housing in the borough, therefore failing to demonstrate the development provides the maximum reasonable amount of affordable housing. The development therefore fails to accord with the requirements of policy LP13 (Affordable Housing) of the Hackney Local Plan LP33 (2020), policy H4 (Delivering Affordable Housing) and Hackney's </span><span style="font-size: 10pt; font-family: Arial, sans-serif; background-color: transparent; font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; vertical-align: baseline; white-space-collapse: preserve;">Planning Contributions SPD (2020) and Chapter 5 of the NPPF 2024.</span></span></p>
